title: MASSP 2.0: 63 subcortical structures of the human brain (nuclei of the basal ganglia, thalamus, midbrain and brainstem, hippocampal subfields, commissures, fornix, internal capsule, claustrum) as a parcellation of the MNI 152 ICBM 2009c asymmetric template at 1 mm
provider: P.-L. Bazin, A. Alkemade, B. U. Forstmann and colleagues (University of Amsterdam), from 7 T quantitative MRI of the AHEAD database; resampled to the 2009c template and served by TemplateFlow
format: NIfTI-1, gzipped, float32 label values 1-63 on the 1 mm grid of the 2009c template (193 x 229 x 193 from (-96, -132, -78) mm), 0 elsewhere; a table of index and name, odd values the left structures and even the right where a structure is paired, single values for midline structures (third and fourth ventricles, fornix, commissures, raphe nuclei).
coverage: The subcortex: basal ganglia, thalamus and its geniculate nuclei, epithalamus, midbrain and pontine nuclei, the hippocampus by subfield, the amygdala, the ventricles, the claustrum, and the major subcortical fibre structures
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the MASSP 2.0 atlases on the UvA/AUAS figshare, doi:10.21942/uva.27291579).
citation: Bazin, P.-L., Alkemade, A., Mulder, M. J., Henry, A. G. and Forstmann, B. U. (2020), Multi-contrast anatomical subcortical structures parcellation, eLife 9, e59430, doi:10.7554/eLife.59430. Bazin, P.-L., Groot, J. M., Miletic, S., Groenewegen, H. J., Trutti, A. C., Mulder, M. J., Forstmann, B. U. and Alkemade, A. (2025), Automated parcellation and atlasing of the human subcortex with ultra-high resolution quantitative MRI, Imaging Neuroscience 3, doi:10.1162/imag_a_00560.
